mapper.insert: INSERT INTO account_wallet( openid, currency, available_amount, total_amount, create_time, update_time ) VALUES( #{openid}, #{currency}, #{availableAmount}, #{totalAmount}, now(), now() ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE available_amount = available_amount + VALUES(available_amount), total_amount = total_amount + VALUES(total_amount), update_time = now()
mapper.select: SELECT id, openid, currency, available_amount, total_amount, create_time, update_time FROM account_wallet WHERE openid = #{openid} FOR UPDATE
